prompts.steps: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a production-ready transparent game UI sprite atlas, one matched pair of square plus and minus buttons for Haven & Hearth Nurgling. Generate a single 1024 by 512 canvas, with EXACTLY two square button sprites side by side in two equal 512x512 cells. Left sprite is PLUS (+); right sprite is MINUS (−). Both sprites have identical dimensions, precisely aligned centers, equal border weight, equal symbol weight. Each button occupies a centered 384x384 square within its 512x512 cell, leaving equal transparent padding on every side. The design must remain legible when reduced to a 16 pixel square: crisp flat orange #E99C54 thin square frame, dark transparent interior, centered orange mathematical plus/minus. Plus has perfectly equal horizontal and vertical stroke lengths and thicknesses, straight and perpendicular, symmetric. Minus is exactly horizontal, equal length and thickness to the plus horizontal stroke. Both symbols are mathematically centered inside their squares. The symbol spans half the interior square. Match the restrained clean orange outline icons of an inventory toolbar on dark charcoal/teal #1C2526. Elegant precise UI icon finish, no decorative fantasy styling. No rounded corners, perspective, 3D bevel, gradient, glow, drop shadow, texture, extra ornament, labels, text, mockup windows or scene. Transparent background outside AND inside both outlined buttons. ONLY these two button sprites on a genuinely transparent canvas.
prompts.buttons:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production game UI button-skin sprite atlas, actual artwork for a live game, NOT a mockup of a desktop application. Canvas 1536x1024 transparent. Exactly SIX wide rectangular empty button plates in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid, one plate centered in each equal 512x512 cell. All six plates have EXACTLY the same 400x160 outer dimensions. No text or symbols. Reading order states: top left NORMAL, top middle HOVER, top right PRESSED; bottom left SELECTED, bottom middle DISABLED, bottom right NORMAL ALTERNATE. Normal uses dark desaturated teal-charcoal center #1C2526 and a restrained aged steel grey edge; Hover a warm orange copper #E99C54 edge with a very subtle warm inner illumination; Pressed a slightly darker inset face and copper edge; Selected a warm brown-charcoal center and a clear thin orange edge; Disabled subdued dark grey-teal with quiet grey edge; Alternate like Normal.
Visual style: polished handcrafted survival-game HUD, clean and compact, consistent with dark Haven & Hearth UI and thin orange inventory toolbar icons. VERY subtle tactile dark surface grain and a narrow copper/steel inlaid rim, small neatly squared corners, restrained painterly finish, readable at 100x28px. The empty central 75 percent must be nearly uniform and seamless for nine-slice stretching; detailed artwork belongs only in the narrow rim. Rectangular square corners, facing dead straight, no perspective. Keep border thickness identical for all states, no bottom selection underline. Opaque dark interior, genuine transparency everywhere outside each plate. NO lettering, labels, icons, examples, arrows, scene, drop shadows, chrome bevels, thick metallic frames, ornate scrollwork, gems, medieval curls or generic fantasy ornament. This is the final usable sprite atlas, not a diagram.
prompts.toolbar:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a single production sprite atlas of 16 tiny orange game toolbar symbols. 1024x1024 square canvas, strict 4 by 4 grid of sixteen equal 256x256 cells. One icon centered in each cell, fits inside a 150x150 square, absolutely no labels or dividers. Read left to right top to bottom:
ROW 1: branching hierarchy/tree diagram for grouping; speech bubble for quest givers; crossed miner's pick and craftsman's hammer for character professions; globe with meridians for world quests.
ROW 2: magnifying glass for search; three horizontal adjustment sliders for settings; a check mark; an X for close.
ROW 3: left chevron; right chevron; up chevron; down chevron.
ROW 4: small wastebasket for discard; four small squares in a 2 by 2 arrangement for grouping stacks; three horizontal descending-length lines with a downward arrow for sort; two diagonal outward arrows for expand.
Style: beautiful, precise, highly legible orange outline icons for the dark inventory HUD of a survival game, #E99C54 copper-orange strokes with restrained illustrated character. Consistent fine but visible strokes, equal optical weight and dimensions. Symmetric and professionally drawn, no clumsy misaligned lines. Readable when reduced to 14 pixels. Completely flat silhouettes and outlines, transparent background both outside and inside line-work. No frames, button plates, gradients, bloom, shadows, chrome, grey details, writing, letters, numbers, realistic tools, generic fantasy decoration or desktop app mockup. Only the 16 specified orange symbols.

Make each rectangle a perfectly straight thin SINGLE-COLOUR border and a completely uniform dark desaturated teal-charcoal interior, square 90-degree corners. Top left NORMAL: solid muted cool-grey frame #596567, solid face #1C2526. Top middle HOVER: solid orange frame #E99C54, solid face #303D3D. Top right PRESSED: solid orange frame #E99C54, solid face #332D24. Bottom left SELECTED: solid orange frame #E99C54, solid face #3E392C. Both have identical squared lock bodies, same body size and baseline, centered small keyhole, same clean warm orange #E99C54 line thickness. Flat simple primitive 2D game HUD style. Thin precise strokes readable at 14 pixels. Body is an outline rectangle with subtly softened corners; shackle is a clean inverted U. Overall glyph fits a centered 280x340 area per 512x512 cell with generous transparent padding. Orange lines only, transparent inside outlines and outside. No frames, no background plates, no metallic material, no rust, no bevel, no gradient, no light, no glow, no shadow, no lettering, no scene, no mockup. Visually match restrained orange inventory controls. The two padlocks must read instantly as open and closed at tiny size.
